FAQ.subtitle: The real doubts that come up when evaluating a technical infrastructure partner.

q1.question: How long does it take to implement the infrastructure?
q1.answer: We operate with **ready-to-deploy systems** and 2-week sprints. The first functional version ships between **6 and 12 weeks**, depending on scope. That contrasts with the 6-18 months needed to build an in-house team from scratch.

q2.question: Who owns the code and what stack do you use?
q2.answer: **Code is 100% yours** — no licensing strings, no vendor lock-in. We work on a modern stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, Vercel/Firebase) with documented CI/CD. We hand over repos under your GitHub org and a technical handoff so any senior team can continue.

q3.question: What's the pricing model?
q3.answer: We start with the **Free Qualification Session (30 min)**. If there's a match, a **USD 4,000 Kick-off** (Model A) follows that defines scope, architecture and the first sprints. From there, fixed monthly sprints with no surprises. For companies that need strategic direction alongside execution, Trinidad exists (Board Model).

q4.question: How do you handle security and data ownership?
q4.answer: End-to-end SSL/TLS encryption, GDPR and Chile Law 19.628 compliance. We host on **your cloud account** (not ours), with audited access via IAM. Implicit NDA from the diagnostic session. No retention of sensitive data outside your perimeter.

q5.question: I don't have an internal tech team. Can I still work with you?
q5.answer: Yes. We act as **your tech team** while you build yours. We document every decision and deliver a **structured technical handoff** so when you hire your CTO or senior squad, they can pick up without friction. We don't aim to lock you in — we aim to make you grow.

q6.question: What's the difference between Sumadots and Trinidad?
q6.answer: **Sumadots** is the execution arm — software factory + automation. **Trinidad** is the strategic head — an alliance of fractional C-Levels (CMO + CPO + CTO). Sumadots executes what Trinidad directs. They work together or separately depending on what your operation needs.

items.question: How do we fund this transformation if our budget is limited?
items.answer: We understand the sector's reality. That's why we design your tech project with the robustness needed to include it in applications to high-impact funds (IDB, GORE, international foundations). The goal is for the system to be financed by the awarded grant, not your current operating resources.

items.question: What stage should our organization be at to work together?
items.answer: Our approach is ideal for teams of 15 to 50 people that already have traction and data but are limited by manual processes or extreme spreadsheet use (like Google Sheets). If you have clear purpose but lack the team to scale in an orderly way, we're the right ally.

items.question: What sets you apart from a traditional software agency?
items.answer: A traditional agency delivers code and leaves. We know technology is useless if your team doesn't adopt it. We focus on operating strategy, training, and ensuring the system actually moves your social indicators (your Social ROI).

items.question: Does our team need to know technology?
items.answer: Not at all. We operate as your expert technology team. We translate your operational needs into automated, easy-to-use solutions. Your team only needs to focus on its core mission: generating impact on the ground.

items.question: What exactly happens in the 30-minute diagnostic?
items.answer: It's a strategic session, not a software pitch. We'll analyze your current bottleneck, review whether your organization is ready for the leap, and deliver a clear map of the next operational steps — whether we end up working together or not.
